Restaurant, conservatory & bar

A locally renowned restaurant in a Victorian house on High Road, with a purpose-built conservatory alongside.

Call to book a table Send an enquiry

The restaurant

Comfortable, spacious and welcoming

Our kitchen cooks Scottish and British dishes, served to hotel guests and visitors alike, in the restaurant or the conservatory beside it.

The restaurant is in the original 1874 house. The conservatory was purpose-built onto the side of it, so you can move between the two: a table in the house for a quiet dinner, or a seat in the glass room on a bright day.

Whether you’re staying with us, meeting friends or gathering the family for a special occasion, you’ll find a warm welcome and food from our own kitchen.

Please call us on 01698 265588 to hear about our current menus, check opening times and reserve a table.

Breakfast

A full Scottish, cooked to order

Breakfast at Bentley Hotel is a full Scottish, cooked when you order it. It’s one of the things our guests mention most.

Your booking confirmation shows whether breakfast is included in your stay. If it isn’t, you’re still welcome to have it: tell us when you book or when you check in and we’ll arrange it for you.

If you’d prefer something lighter than the full Scottish, or you have a dietary requirement, just say so and we’ll tell you what we can do.

Catching an early train? Let us know the evening before and we’ll see what we can arrange.

Lunch & dinner

Scottish and British cooking, done properly

Our menus are built on Scottish and British dishes: familiar food, cooked well and served without fuss.

The restaurant suits a lunch between meetings, a relaxed dinner after a day on the road, or a family meal with three generations round one table. Children are welcome: tell us how many are coming and their ages when you book, and we’ll seat you comfortably.

Menus change, so rather than print them here we’d ask you to call us on 01698 265588. We’ll tell you what’s on, when we’re serving and whether we have a table for you.

Restaurant opening times vary through the week and can change, so please call before you set out, particularly on a Sunday or a bank holiday.

  • Scottish and British dishes from our own kitchen
  • Seating in the restaurant or the conservatory
  • Family meals, with children welcome
  • Bookings by phone on 01698 265588
  • Free on-site parking while you eat

Family occasions

A table, or a room, of your own

Some meals are more than a meal. A birthday, an anniversary, a christening, or a gathering after a funeral all need a bit more room and a bit more care, and we’re used to providing both. Tell us the occasion, the number of guests and the date, and we’ll suggest the right space and talk menus with you.

A table in the restaurant

For a family lunch or a small celebration, we can reserve a long table in the restaurant. Order from the menu as usual, or ask us about a menu for the whole party.

The conservatory

A bright room beside the house, and the natural choice for a smaller party that would like a space of its own. Ask us about reserving it for your group.

The function suite

For larger gatherings, our air-conditioned function suite seats up to 100 for a meal and holds up to 120 for a reception, with the same kitchen behind it.

Functions and celebrations

Celebrations

Milestone birthdays, wedding anniversaries, christening lunches and family get-togethers: tell us what you’re marking and we’ll help you plan it, from the seating plan to the moment the cake comes out. If guests are travelling, ask us about bedrooms for them.

Funeral receptions

We know a funeral tea is often arranged at short notice and at a difficult time. Call us and we’ll keep things simple: a private space, a straightforward choice of food, and staff who will look after your guests so you don’t have to.

The bar

A drink at the end of the day

Bentley Hotel has its own bar: somewhere to unwind after a day’s work, raise a glass before dinner, or catch up with friends after the match at Fir Park.

It’s open to hotel guests, diners and visitors alike. If you’re planning a wedding with us, our wedding package includes a late licence until 1am.

Bar and restaurant opening times can change, so please call us to check before you visit.

Dietary needs & allergies

Tell us, and we’ll talk it through

If you have an allergy, intolerance or dietary requirement, we’d much rather know in advance. Our kitchen will talk you through the dishes and the ingredients we use, and tell you plainly what we can and can’t do.

When you book

Mention any allergies or requirements when you reserve your table, so the kitchen knows before you arrive.

When you order

Remind your server when you order. They’ll check with the kitchen and go through the dishes and their ingredients with you.

For a party or function

Send us a list of your guests’ requirements in advance. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free or anything else: the more notice we have, the more we can offer.

Everything is prepared in the same kitchen, so if an allergy is severe please tell us, and we’ll discuss how we handle and prepare food before you decide what to order.

Food hygiene

Inspected and passed

Like other food businesses in Scotland, our kitchen is inspected by the local council under the Food Hygiene Information Scheme, which Food Standards Scotland runs with local authorities. Businesses that are inspected receive either a Pass or an Improvement Required result.

Bentley Hotel’s result is a Pass. The inspection was carried out by North Lanarkshire Council in December 2025, and you can check the result for yourself on the Food Standards Agency’s ratings site.

Visiting us

The practical details

You don’t need to be staying at the hotel to eat with us. We’re on High Road, next door to the North Lanarkshire Heritage Centre and about 5 minutes’ walk from Motherwell station, with free parking on site.

The simplest way to book is to call. If you’re planning further ahead, or you have a celebration in mind, send us an enquiry and we’ll come back to you.

Restaurant questions

Do I need to book a table?

We’d recommend it, especially for dinner, weekends and groups. Opening times vary, so a quick call on 01698 265588 saves a wasted journey and lets us have a table ready for you.

Are children welcome?

Yes. Families are a big part of what we do, from a meal out together to a christening lunch. Tell us how many children are coming and their ages when you book, and we’ll make sure you have a comfortable table.

Can you cater for allergies and dietary requirements?

Please tell us when you book and again when you order. We’ll explain what goes into each dish, and be honest about what we can and can’t do. For a party, send us your guests’ requirements in advance.

Can we hire the conservatory or a private room for a party?

Yes. The conservatory suits smaller parties that would like a space of their own, and for larger gatherings our function suite seats up to 100 for a meal. Send us the date and numbers and we’ll talk through the options and menus. There’s more on our functions page.

Planning a meal or a celebration?

Call the hotel to book a table, or send us the details of your occasion.
